info.title: LOOP Web API
info.description: Decision 0179: the LOOP website's registration surface /v2/web/*. Same Privy App and Bearer verification as the App; no App device-session or client-version header. Writes need X-Loop-Contract-Version: 2.0 and a lower-case UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key. CORS only for the origins in WEB_ORIGINS (echoed, never *); errors are the seven-field V2 envelope with detailsSafe.reasonCode.

post.summary: Sign in on the website: get or create the LOOP account
post.description: Decision 0179. Verifies the Privy access token (same Privy App and verifier as the App). The first call for a Privy user creates the LOOP account and its LOOP ID; later calls (website or App) return the same account. No App device session is created and no device / platform / client-version header is read. Idempotency-Key is required and validated; the operation is naturally idempotent (get-or-create).

parameters.description: Lower-case canonical UUIDv4, new per user action.

canClaim.description: Not bound, the referral module is available, and the window is not closed. Before the username is set the window has not started yet: set the username first, then claim.

put.description: Decision 0179. Same rules and services as the App: a pending profile is activated with this alias (the App's one-time activation command; the Idempotency-Key replays it, the same key with another username is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT); an active profile has its alias replaced (compare-and-swap, one automatic retry on a concurrent edit; setting the current name is a no-op). Activation starts the 7-day invite-claim window. 409 ACCOUNT_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED before POST /v2/web/session.

username.description: Same rule as the App alias: trimmed to 1-40 Unicode code points, no control / bidi / invisible formatting characters, not unique. Reserved words → 422 ALIAS_RESERVED, operator-blocked terms → 422 ALIAS_BLOCKED, over 40 code points → 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: Bind the account to an inviter with an invite code
post.description: Decision 0179. The App's claim service and every check unchanged: once per account, only after the username (activation) and inside the 7-day window, not the caller's own code, no cycle; edges up to depth 5 in one transaction; the same Idempotency-Key replays the original result. An account that is already bound gets 200 already_bound (no write). Refusals carry detailsSafe.reasonCode: 400 REFERRAL_CODE_INVALID, 404 REFERRAL_CODE_UNKNOWN, 403 REFERRAL_CLAIM_WINDOW_CLOSED, 409 PROFILE_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED, 422 REFERRAL_SELF_INVITE | REFERRAL_CYCLE.

get.summary: Who invited me: the owner of an invite code
get.description: Decision 0179. No authentication, no contract headers. valid=false (inviter null) for a malformed or unknown code; otherwise the owner's LOOP ID and username (null until the owner activated a profile). Nothing else about the owner is published. Per-visitor fixed one-minute window (PUBLIC_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE, the Decision 0147 limiter): 429 RATE_LIMITED / WEB_RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After.

get.summary: My invites: code, link, counts, invitees, inviter
get.description: Decision 0180. Bearer only (no contract, idempotency, or device headers are read). The App's invite-center reads: the invite code is issued on the first read (also before the username), stats use the Decision 0162 source (valid = the invitee's own power > 0 in the newest settled hour), invitees are the direct ones newest first, 100 a page with an owner-bound cursor. Invitees show only LOOP ID and username. 409 ACCOUNT_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED before POST /v2/web/session; 503 V2_REFERRAL_MODULE_DEFERRED / V2_CURSOR_NOT_CONFIGURED / WEB_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's nextCursor (owner-bound, opaque). Omit for the first page.

cache-control.description: Sensitive and operational responses are never cached

code.description: The caller's own invite code (LOOP-XXXXC). Issued on the account's first invite-center read (App or website), before the username is set; never changes.

inviteLink.description: {PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/i/{code}, the same link the App shares (Universal Link / App Link; 302 to the website when WEB_BASE_URL is set).

valid.description: Direct invitees in force whose own mining power was > 0 in the newest settled hour.

validAsOf.description: End of the settled hour `valid` is read from.

stats.description: Null before the first settled mining hour or when the figures cannot be read (unknown, never zeros).

invitees.description: Direct invitees (depth 1, in force and void), newest binding first; the App's invite list.

loopId.description: Null when the invitee blocked the caller.

username.description: Active profile alias; null before the invitee set a username or when the invitee blocked the caller.

status.description: valid: own mining power > 0 in the newest settled hour; pending: in force, not (yet) valid; void: relationship invalidated.

nextCursor.description: Present when more invitees exist: GET again with ?cursor=. The other fields are re-read on every page.

inviter.description: The caller's direct inviter; null when unbound.

windowEndsAt.description: Activation + 7 days; null before the username (activation).

canClaim.description: Not bound and the window is not closed (before the username: set it first, then claim).
